task.title: L8a.1: release-owned GPU backend manifest, backend-aware runtime pin, signed manifest and offline validation
task.objective: Phase L L8a.1 (awkit-djnl.11). Add the release-owned backend manifest for user-supplied GPU backend packs beside AI_MODEL_MANIFEST (src/offline/ai-backend-manifest.json, exported typed as AI_BACKEND_MANIFEST from src/offline/AiModelManifest.ts): the pinned node-llama-cpp@3.21.1+llama.cpp@v0.4.0 build and, for the Vulkan backend, every file of @node-llama-cpp/win-x64-vulkan@3.21.1 by path, size and SHA-256 as measured by the L8a.0 gate, with a structural validator that refuses unsafe paths, bad hashes, duplicates and a missing addon. Make AI_RUNTIME_PIN backend-aware with an explicit backend set (cpu shipped, vulkan user-supplied) without breaking its strict single-build parsers. Fold the backend manifest into the Ed25519-signed dependency manifest as aiGpuBackends (bundled: false) in scripts/generate-dependency-manifest.ps1, and have scripts/validate-offline-bundle.ps1 check the source manifest's structure, its agreement with the pin, the signed copy's equality with the source, and that no pinned GPU backend binary ships in the installer. Prove it with a new verify:ai-backend-manifest (the source against the installed prebuilt, structural negative controls, the validator's new rules black-box on scratch roots, and the committed signed manifest) and a fresh package:portable whose in-pipeline strict validation runs the new rules. The installer's own app-local Visual C++ runtime is copied beside an imported pack by L8a.2, so it is not part of the backend manifest. No host protocol, handshake, mode, Settings, import or permission change: those are L8a.2 and L8a.3.

security: Do not alter signing-key custody; the dependency manifest is signed only by the existing pipeline.
No GPU binary enters the installer; the backend manifest carries hashes only.
offline: No runtime download, GPU requirement, global runtime or admin right is introduced.

acceptance.description: The backend manifest pins every runtime file of the installed @node-llama-cpp/win-x64-vulkan@3.21.1 exactly (set, size and SHA-256), agrees with AI_RUNTIME_PIN's build and backend set, and its structural validator refuses each negative control.

A fresh package carries the backend manifest in the signed dependency manifest as aiGpuBackends, and strict offline validation checks it against the source and finds no pinned GPU binary in the installer.
Typecheck, bundles and the script typecheck pass; the verifier is registered.

evidence.observed: Final state: 40 passed, 0 failed. A 26/26 (source resolves to the frozen vulkan entry, pin backends cpu+vulkan, 15 structural and 5 resolver negative controls refused), B 2/2 (24 installed runtime files = 24 pinned, every size and SHA-256 equal), C 10/10 (validator control clean; signed copy absent, different, bundled; source build, traversal, case-variant duplicate, no addon; pin without vulkan; a pinned binary shipped under another name: each draws its own message), D 2/2 (committed signed manifest verifies and its aiGpuBackends equals the source). Before packaging D failed as expected (no section yet), 39/1. The first run failed all of C: under the dot-sourced Set-StrictMode Latest, an if expression unrolled a one-element match list and .Count threw PropertyNotFoundStrict; fixed by wrapping the whole if in @() and initializing $aiPinBody. Mutation: with the validator's pinned-binary hash collection disabled, exactly the control (tightened to require a non-zero binary count) and the shipped-binary case failed, 38/2; reverted.

From clean dadd17bb: build, host staging (AI tree 1465 files, 51.5 MB, CPU only), fresh-state 10/10, dependency manifest generated and signed with ed25519:aa5b9dd8..., strict validation passed, portable SpecterStudio 0.1.51.exe written. The signed manifest was committed at 3e105d7b. verify:ai-packaged-runtime on this package: 104 passed, 0 failed, including the live harness 13/13 with the pinned 0.8B and the packaged tree equal to the current staging.

Run by package-portable.ps1 as validate-offline-bundle.ps1 -Strict, on the same inputs that were then committed: 'Local-AI GPU backend manifest: 1 backend(s), 24 files pinned for node-llama-cpp@3.21.1+llama.cpp@v0.4.0; the signed copy matches the source.', 'none of its 20 pinned binaries is among the 1465 shipped local-AI files (compared by SHA-256).', 'Strict mode: passed.' Not rerun separately: its inputs did not change after that run.
tsc --noEmit and electron-vite build passed after the manifest and pin change, and again inside package:portable. npm run typecheck:scripts passed with the new verifier.
279 verify:/validate: scripts classified, integration 52, classification reconciled.

completion.qa_basis: verify:ai-backend-manifest 40/0 with one caught validator mutation, package:portable with in-pipeline strict validation, verify:ai-packaged-runtime 104/0 on the fresh package, build, typecheck:scripts and verify:verifier-classification.
completion.qa_known_limitations: The Vulkan pack is pinned and validated, but nothing imports or loads it yet (L8a.2, L8a.3); the host handshake still compares only the build string. The release does not yet produce a distributable pack folder: the pack is the pinned npm prebuilt's runtime files. No NSIS installer was rebuilt; only the portable. QC was not performed by an independent reviewer.
completion.qc_basis: Independent QC 2026-09-30 (awkit-djnl.15, contract awkit-djnl-15-l8a-qc-0930): a second model family (GPT-5.6 Luna through CodeCraft) reviewed isValidAiBackendManifestEntry, resolveAiBackendManifest and the signed-trust comparison on the current code and found no defect; checked against source by Claude. No change was needed.
